description: Source code for parsing and handling watchdog service configurations, including XML parsing, default settings, and management of service definitions.

methods.name: parseConfiguration
methods.description: Parses the XML configuration file to build a list of service definitions.

methods.name: applyDefaults
methods.description: Applies global default settings to a serviceDefinition object.

methods.name: parseManagerNode
methods.description: Parses a <manager> XML node into a serviceDefinition structure.

methods.name: parseJavaNode
methods.description: Parses a <javaDef> XML node into a serviceDefinition structure.

methods.name: parseDefaultsNode
methods.description: Parses a <defaults> XML node to set default configuration values.

methods.name: parseArgList
methods.description: Parses an <argList> XML node into an argument array.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a search string with a replacement in a given input string.

methods.name: substituteMarkers
methods.description: Replaces configuration and home directory markers in a string.

methods.name: destroyServiceDefinition
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a serviceDefinition object.

methods.name: loadServiceConfig
methods.description: Loads and parses the watchdog service configuration file into a list of service definitions.

methods.name: saveMisbehavingService
methods.description: Saves the name of a misbehaving service to persistent storage.

methods.name: readMisbehavingService
methods.description: Reads and deletes the stored name of a misbehaving service from persistent storage.
